title: Can I have the apple one, please?
scene: 零食时间，他挑要哪个、要几个。

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: The snacks are on the table, and you can pick one for yourself.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Can I have the apple one, please?

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Sure, you can have the apple one. But just one snack, okay?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: But I want two of them. My tummy says I need two.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: You can have one now, and you can have another one after we go to the park.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Okay, that's fine. But I get to pick which one I eat later.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: It's a deal. But you need to wash your hands first.

variations: "apple one" 换 "banana one"；"after the park" 换 "after nap"。
